body:
Tested locally, it works as expected. Code looks good to me.

Note that regardless of this PR, there's a performance issue when editing the GridMap in the 3D platformer demo. Placing or removing any block is *very* slow (1.5+ seconds) with a debug editor build (about 0.5 seconds with an optimized build). The editor is completely frozen just after the block is placed. It seems to be related to the octant size, as editing is snappy with an octant size up to 10 but it gets pretty slow past that. This issue also occurs in 4.4.1.stable, so it's not a recent regression.

**Edit:** I found the issue – it's caused by Jolt having much slower shape updates in this scenario. Switching to GodotPhysics3D resolves the performance bottleneck entirely (64 octant size is still fairly smooth to edit).

**Edit 2:** The issue is being tracked in https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/105642.
